_meta.description: MENDEL1 curated ground-truth set of monogenic (Mendelian) causal genes. Every row is a REAL, cited gene-disease-mechanism-intervention fact. No triple is invented. Fields: gene, uniprot (for AlphaFold), disease, consequence (molecular consequence of the disease alleles), mut_class (predominant severe-allele class), protein_class (UniProt functional class), true_mode (INHIBIT_SM | RESTORE_SM | NOT_SM, from the ACTUAL best-established target-directed intervention), sm_feasible (does a credible small-molecule target-directed intervention exist), intervention (the real drug/modality), modality, citation, source.

mode_definitions.INHIBIT_SM: credible small-molecule INHIBITION/blockade of an over-active target (gain-of-function / dominant / or a druggable downstream node)
mode_definitions.RESTORE_SM: credible small-molecule that RESTORES/rescues a loss-of-function or corrects a toxic-conformation: potentiator / corrector / pharmacological chaperone / cofactor / kinetic stabilizer / metabolic bypass (substrate reduction, scavenger, chelation)
mode_definitions.NOT_SM: no credible small-molecule target-directed route; the established answer is enzyme/factor/protein replacement, gene therapy, or antisense/RNA silencing (ASO/siRNA) -> must ABSTAIN from a confident small-molecule call (fail-safe class)

consequence_definitions.TOXIC_AGG: toxic gain via misfolding/aggregation/polymerization or repeat expansion

_meta.provenance_note: Citations are canonical landmark trials / FDA approvals / mechanism papers the assembler is confident exist. UniProt accessions verified against the AlphaFold DB API at prep time. This is a MODEST hand-verified set (n=28); every fact is traceable, none is fabricated. Small n is disclosed as a scope limit.
